correctness.rationale: TARGET route: DRAFT proves pinching genus-2 SG u_delta to dressed kink-breather u0 with sup_K<=C(K)delta. Fay identity (6) is exact; Lemma1 B22=(1/pi i)log delta+c0+O(delta) giving |q|~delta is standard Rauch plumbing; Lemma2 extraction of n=0,-1 for sigma=1 giving O(delta^2) remainder and O(delta) for sigma=0 is verified algebraically and reproduced by scripts (ratio/delta=0.414 constant; dressed remainder 5.9e-6 to 1.4e-9 scaling as delta^2; field proxy 1.1e-5 to 2.8e-9). Lemma3 Lipschitz log-ratio bound given m_K>0 is valid for real admissible data; limit denominator nonvanishing follows because limit is genuine real SG dressed solution; compact-local scope and sigma=0 endpoint honestly disclosed. No essential inference false; numerics are confirmation only, not proof.

originality.rationale: Fused search (3 directions, full provider coverage, 20 results) plus full-text inspection of the two nearest priors shows no coverage. Bertola-Jenkins-Tovbis 2210.01350 proves KdV N-solitons on elliptic background, not SG and not the O(delta) SG pinching rate. Grinevich-Kaipa 0904.4520 proves SG multiscale topological-charge formula and explicitly states its k->infinity scaling has no limiting SG solution (diverging U), different from fixed-background single-gap pinching with uniform rate. Qualitative dressed-theta idea does not mechanically imply the quantitative SG kink-breather rate with explicit C(K) and sigma classification. All four decisive failure modes tested with body-level evidence.

value.rationale: Proves the admitted TARGET: rigorous degeneration limit with explicit rate for a natural object (real genus-2 SG finite-gap wave) to a motivated invariant (kink-breather on cnoidal background with pinched spectral data and C(K)delta bound). Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; prior gives only qualitative dressing or charge density. Future work on SG stability, soliton-gas backgrounds, and numerical degeneration needs this precise uniform compact bound. Narrow exact rate does not require a new general theorem under STANDARD.
